title: Jam or fold, heads-up, 2 to 15 big blinds

games.title: Jam or fold, heads-up, 2 big blinds
betting: before the flop, the button moves all-in for 2 big blinds or folds
facing the all-in, the big blind calls or folds
a called hand is dealt to the river with no more betting
games.caveat: This is the equilibrium of a simplified game in which the button may only move all-in or fold and the big blind may only call or fold. Real players can also limp or make a smaller raise. Those options matter more the deeper the stacks, so the chart is a sound guide at the shortest stacks and a looser one towards 15 big blinds; how much they are worth is not measured here.
